serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: How was it {f_botName}?
Bot: It was fun, but I was kinda afraid for my life at some moments…
You: I think Shanice knows what she’s doing.{{wi}} Even if it doesn’t appear like it…
Bot: She’s skilled, that’s a fact. 
You: Do you think you could beat her someday at skating?
Bot: With enough tweaking in my hardware and software…
Bot: I probably could, but I don’t wanna. One wrong move and I would end up in a scrap yard…
You: Haha! So there’s something that people are better than bots!
#bot.Expression.angry
Bot: T-That’s only because Shanice has no sense of self-preservation! 
#bot.Expression.clear
